ruleDefinitions.name: Reg Add Suspicious Paths
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when an adversary uses the reg.exe utility to add or modify new keys or subkeys

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppDataLow\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\OOBE.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Winlogon.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\Currentversion\\\\Winlogon.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\SecurityProviders\\\\WDigest.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\.*")))
